# statusdrift_monitor_group (Resource)

Manages a StatusDrift monitor group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "statusdrift_monitor_group" "production" {
  name = "Production Services"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the monitor group (max 255 characters).

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the monitor group.
